CustomField.description: Multiplier applied to this count when several Load Metric rows are combined into one load score. Defaults to 1. Use 2 to make one count matter twice as much as another, or 0.5 to make it matter half as much. Ignored when Role is Cap only.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How much this count counts toward the load score. 1 is normal.
CustomField.label: Load Weight
